{{Attr|Aggro}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Snowy''' is a fast enemy that appears in the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. Like most of that mode's enemies, it first appeared in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. It has a low amount of health and fast speed. During the event, it walked at the same speed as the [[Frozen]]. ==Logbook Description== "''Snowy is a creature that dwells on mountain peaks and within ice caves. What resembles fur is actually compacted snow from blizzards, and their sharp claws are used to climb ice. They often hunt in packs but remain mostly solitary.''" ==Appearance== The '''Snowy''' is a Yeti-like creature with white fur and neon blue eyes. It has two sharp blue teeth in its mouth and multiple blue horns its body. ==Strategy== *Early-game towers like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Golden Soldier]], [[Cowboy]] or [[Crook Boss]] can be useful against it. **As these spawn in hordes, AOE towers like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Archer]] can also be pretty effective. *As the '''Snowy''' is somewhat fast, early-game towers which can stall it, like the [[Toxic Gunner]] or [[Electroshocker]] can help with its speed, while also being strong enough to deal decent damage to it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Snowy1.png|Green variant, current version, first animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1Snowy2.png|Green variant, current version, second animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1Snowy3.png|Green variant, current version, third animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1Snowy4.png|Green variant, current version, fourth animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSnowyAnim1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) CorpseSnowyAnim2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) CorpseSnowyAnim3.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, third animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) CorpseSnowyAnim4.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, fourth animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SnowyIconIG.png|'''Snowy''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Snowy''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' -
